Publication statement: Roma : Presso la Calcografia Camerale, [1825?]

Relief shown pictorially. Attributed to being engraved by Bernardino Olivieri in the Catalogo delle stampe della Calcografia Camerale, Rome, 1842. Prime meridian: Paris. Plates individually numbered no. 1-9 in upper right corner. Includes numbered political division index on plate no. 7. Sheets bound; front and back cover are sheets of rice paper.
